name: Claude Opus 5

weak.d: 73% of its evaluations are lab-unique, including most of its agentic suite.

res.d: 91 disclosed evaluations, the widest record of any card in this set.

lims: 73% lab-unique — the agentic suite has no cross-lab equivalent.
Novel scales — GDPval-AA and AA-Briefcase report on scales peers do not use.
Comparability — few scores can be placed against a competitor.
blurb: 91 disclosed evaluations, the widest record in the set, and 73% of them lab-unique. Breadth of disclosure and comparability of disclosure are not the same thing.

ability.name: Abstraction
ability.text: Near-ceiling on ARC-AGI-1 and clear of the field on ARC-AGI-2, strongest at problems it has not seen a template for.
